pergunta: A player's phone rang during the game. What's the rule?

hits.texto: Unless authorised by the arbiter, it is forbidden for anybody to use a mobile phone or any kind of communication device in the playing venue or any contiguous area designated by the arbiter.
hits.artigo_titulo: Article 12: The Role of the Arbiter (see Preface)

hits.texto: During a game, a player is forbidden to have any electronic device not specifically approved by the arbiter in the playing venue.
hits.artigo_titulo: Article 11: The Conduct of the Players

hits.texto: It is forbidden to record the moves in advance, unless the player is claiming a draw according to Article 9.2, or 9.3 or adjourning a game according to Guidelines I.1.1
hits.artigo_titulo: Article 8: The recording of the moves

hits.texto: It is forbidden to distract or annoy the opponent in any manner whatsoever. This includes unreasonable claims, unreasonable offers of a draw or the introduction of a source of noise into the playing area.
hits.artigo_titulo: Article 11: The Conduct of the Players

hits.texto: Both players must record the offer of a draw on the scoresheet with a symbol (=).
hits.artigo_titulo: Article 8: The recording of the moves
